why: In next/ and the lint tooling, one fix round for ticket 1067: CI's typecheck was red on oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts. The kept list in M13 was declared as const, so its retries row's folders narrowed to a one-literal tuple and folders.includes(folder) refused a string. It is now typed as a read-only array of rows whose folders are a read-only array of strings, with no cast and no disable. Main (PR 1636) was merged first, with no conflict; its hunks in plants.test.ts and builtin-plants.ts were read and kept as they are. No law was weakened: M13 keeps every check.

plants.law: scenario: M13 process stdout and stderr are refused in libfabrika's product and test-support files, taken in its test files, and no other entry is lost
plants.plant: Dropped the two process entries from the next/packages/libfabrika/src/** copy block in .oxlintrc.json. Restored by copy.

note: Node 26.13.0, TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset. oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts passes (266 tests); tsc in oxlint-plugins exits 0; one whole-repo pnpm typecheck exits 0. pnpm lint: the parallel run lost lint:kind and lint:promise-types to the known tsgo broken-pipe crash, and each passes run alone; every other part passed.
